title: Senior Web Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join Street Diligence Inc. as a Senior Web Application Engineer, where you will play a key role in architecting and developing high-performance web applications. Your expertise in modern web development—including JavaScript frameworks, reusable UI components, and responsive design—will drive our innovative solutions. While experience with frameworks like Frappe and Django is an asset, we are primarily focused on robust full-stack development that leverages current technologies to build scalable and intuitive applications. A genuine passion for great user experiences is a must.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Development:

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue) along with backend technologies.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and engaging user interfaces that prioritize excellent user experiences.
  • Maintain a clean, efficient, and sustainable codebase following best practices.

Technical Leadership:

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance on modern web development practices, focusing on component-driven architectures and best coding practices.
  • Help conduct thorough code reviews to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies and assess their potential to enhance our web development processes.
  • Help establish robust component libraries and expand object composition

Project Management:

  • Collaborate with project managers and cross-functional teams to define project scopes, requirements, and timelines.
  • Lead technical planning and architecture discussions, ensuring that projects meet both business and technical goals.
  • Ensure on-time delivery of projects with a consistent focus on quality.

Testing and Optimization:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies to ensure the performance and reliability of our applications.
  • Demonstrate a passion for unit test coverage and behavior tests to maintain a high-quality codebase.
  • Optimize web applications for speed, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate design concepts into functional, visually appealing interfaces.
  • Partner with backend engineers to define and implement robust API integrations.
  • Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years’ experience in web application development, with strong expertise in both frontend and backend technologies.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue).
  • Experience with backend technologies such as Django, Node.js, or similar frameworks.
  • Familiarity with building reusable UI components and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Additional Skills:
  • Strong understanding of SQL database technologies.
  • A passion for great user experiences, unit test coverage, and behavior tests.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a drive to build innovative solutions.
  • Outstanding communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Sr. Big Data Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Big Data Engineer  to join the Customer Identity (CI) team that is central to the enterprise, focused on ensuring customer data is accurate, consistent, and readily accessible. This critical data is the foundation for essential business processes, including personalized marketing, analytical reporting, and seamless online and in-store checkout and customer service experiences.


They manage a wide array of high-performance, scalable batch and real-time services. These services are utilized at numerous customer interactions, such as in-store purchases, online orders, rewards program enrollments, and activations from various marketing channels (Email, Direct Mail, SMS, Push notifications, etc.). By leveraging modern development practices, tools, and technology platforms, the CI team builds capabilities that empower customer-facing and checkout teams to deliver personalized, relevant, and frictionless experiences, ensuring customers realize value with every interaction.


Core hours:

This team operates in every major US time zone from Pacific to Eastern. Core hours would be considered 10 am CST - 4 pm CST with 2 hours spilling over either direction based on location.


Required Skills:

Non-Negotiable Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Data Engineer or in a closely related role.
  • Strong experience with Python.
  • Hands-on experience with Airflow.
  • Experience working with Scala.
  • Experience with Spark, Spark SQL, and Spark Streaming.
  • Experience designing and working with relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Direct experience using Apache Kafka.
  • Strong ability to write complex SQL queries.
  • Experience with GCP, including BigQuery, BigTable, and Dataproc.
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs in data pipelines.


Tech Stack:

Python, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, Spark SQL, Spark Streaming, Kafka, Relational Databases, NoSQL Databases, GCP BigQuery, BigTable, Dataproc, RESTful APIs.


Bonus Skills:

Experience with Databriks, Snowflake, Java, Springboot.


Duration:  3 months; end date being March 31, 2026, with the possibility of being extended based on team needs.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a leading retail innovator transforming the shopping experience through cutting-edge technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

description:

This role is analytical, consultative, and performance-driven. You are a partner, not support. If you understand real estate investing, SMS performance, and how to turn data into outcomes, this role fits. This is a direct hire role.

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.

  • Drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell opportunities tied directly to customer value

  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

  • Architectural Contributions:  Collaborate with the team on architectural decisions, ensuring their systems are secure, maintainable, and designed for long-term scalability.


Qualifications:

Required:

  • Experience:  6-10 years of professional software development experience, ideally in a full-stack capacity.
  • Backend Expertise:  Strong proficiency with GoLang (Go) for developing performant microservices and APIs.

Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a cutting-edge company revolutionizing in-store digital media and data-driven storytelling.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Sobre a vaga:


Você tem familiaridade com SAFe , gosta de ambientes ágeis complexos e quer apoiar grandes times a entregarem valor de forma estruturada e eficiente? Essa vaga pode ser sua!


O que você vai fazer:


  • Suportar o Release Train Engineer (RTE) na gestão e otimização do fluxo de entrega de valor de um Agile Release Train (ART) ;
  • Apoiar a execução dos Program Increments (PI), participando da preparação, realização e retrospectiva de eventos como PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, PO Syncs, System Demos, Inspect & Adapt ;

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Tech Lead .NET Core
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Código da oportunidade: 56624


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core / .NET 6+ .
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST , gRPC, WebAPI e boas práticas de design (DDD, SOLID).
  • Experiência com Entity Framework , LINQ , e integração com bancos relacionais (SQL Server) e NoSQL.
  • Domínio de React.js , Hooks , Context API , e boas práticas de componentização.
  • Experiência com Microfrontends (ex.: Module Federation).
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript , Webpack , CSS-in-JS .
  • Autenticação JWT com OAuth2, SAML (desejável)


  • Arquitetura:
  • Experiência comprovada com microserviços e event-driven architecture .
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (ex.: RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Padrões de observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing).
  • Experiencia com integração com sistemas


  • Cloud (AWS):
  • Experiência com ECS/EKS , Lambda , API Gateway , S3 , CloudWatch , RDS/DynamoDB .
  • Infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK ).
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, GitLab).


  • DevOps & Qualidade:
  • Integração contínua, pipelines de build/deploy.
  • Testes automatizados (unitários, integração, end-to-end).
  • Monitoramento e escalabilidade.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Web Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join Street Diligence Inc. as a Senior Web Application Engineer, where you will play a key role in architecting and developing high-performance web applications. Your expertise in modern web development—including JavaScript frameworks, reusable UI components, and responsive design—will drive our innovative solutions. While experience with frameworks like Frappe and Django is an asset, we are primarily focused on robust full-stack development that leverages current technologies to build scalable and intuitive applications. A genuine passion for great user experiences is a must.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Development:

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue) along with backend technologies.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and engaging user interfaces that prioritize excellent user experiences.
  • Maintain a clean, efficient, and sustainable codebase following best practices.

Technical Leadership:

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance on modern web development practices, focusing on component-driven architectures and best coding practices.
  • Help conduct thorough code reviews to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies and assess their potential to enhance our web development processes.
  • Help establish robust component libraries and expand object composition

Project Management:

  • Collaborate with project managers and cross-functional teams to define project scopes, requirements, and timelines.
  • Lead technical planning and architecture discussions, ensuring that projects meet both business and technical goals.
  • Ensure on-time delivery of projects with a consistent focus on quality.

Testing and Optimization:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies to ensure the performance and reliability of our applications.
  • Demonstrate a passion for unit test coverage and behavior tests to maintain a high-quality codebase.
  • Optimize web applications for speed, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate design concepts into functional, visually appealing interfaces.
  • Partner with backend engineers to define and implement robust API integrations.
  • Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years’ experience in web application development, with strong expertise in both frontend and backend technologies.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue).
  • Experience with backend technologies such as Django, Node.js, or similar frameworks.
  • Familiarity with building reusable UI components and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Additional Skills:
  • Strong understanding of SQL database technologies.
  • A passion for great user experiences, unit test coverage, and behavior tests.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a drive to build innovative solutions.
  • Outstanding communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a highly capable and experienced Full-Stack Software Engineer to join their team. This role is ideal for a senior-level engineer who thrives on owning features end-to-end, from database schema design to frontend UI implementation.


This is a critical role that requires a solid grasp of modern, decoupled architecture and the ability to work effectively across the entire stack.


Key Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Feature Development:  Design, build, and deploy new features and services across their product suite, ensuring high performance, responsiveness, and reliability.
  • Backend Engineering:  Develop and maintain core backend services using GoLang, implement efficient and scalable APIs using GraphQL, and manage their relational data infrastructure on Postgres.
  • Frontend Development:  Build intuitive, performant, and engaging user interfaces using Angular and Typescript, specifically focusing on internal dashboards, content management tools, and data visualization applications.
  • Cloud Infrastructure:  Utilize GCP (Google Cloud Platform) services to deploy, monitor, and scale their applications (e.g., Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL).
  • Architectural Contributions:  Collaborate with the team on architectural decisions, ensuring their systems are secure, maintainable, and designed for long-term scalability.


Qualifications:

Required:

  • Experience:  6-10 years of professional software development experience, ideally in a full-stack capacity.
  • Backend Expertise:  Strong proficiency with GoLang (Go) for developing performant microservices and APIs.
  • Database : Deep experience with Postgres (PostgreSQL), including advanced SQL, performance tuning, and database schema design.
  • Frontend Mastery:  Proven experience with JavaScript frameworks and Typescript to build complex, enterprise-grade web applications. Angular proficiency is preferred; otherwise, willingness to learn it is a must.
  • API Design:  Experience designing, building, and consuming APIs, with a preference for GraphQL.
  • Cloud Platform:  Hands-on experience deploying and managing applications on GCP (Google Cloud Platform) or another major cloud provider.


Preferred (Bonus Points):

  • Startup/Early Stage Experience:  Previous experience working in a small, fast-paced environment (e.g., on a team of 1-2 engineers), where independent problem-solving and wearing multiple hats were essential.
  • Media or Retail Tech:  Familiarity with concepts in AdTech, digital signage, content delivery networks (CDNs), or retail/CPG data environments.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a cutting-edge company revolutionizing in-store digital media and data-driven storytelling.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Onboarding Specialist. You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. This role defines the customer’s first impression of Smarter Contact and has clear growth potential within a fast-scaling SaaS company. This is a direct-hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Lead and follow up on all 1-1 or group onboarding sessions via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Guide customers through initial setup, configuration, and first live campaigns
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Ensure customers reach defined activation milestones within the onboarding window
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or risk during onboarding-escalate and resolve
  • Document onboarding outcomes, next steps, and handoff notes clearly in CRM
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience to ensure a clean transition post onboarding
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Freelance Photographer
description:
We are seeking skilled and reliable freelance photographers to support an upcoming visual content initiative. This role involves capturing a small set of high-quality images following a general creative brief. Photographers may work with models or self-shoot, depending on preference and availability.

This is a great opportunity for photographers looking to take on flexible contract work, build their portfolio, or collaborate on a unique project.

About the Role

Photographers will be responsible for producing a series of clear, well-lit images that meet the project’s technical and creative guidelines. The work can be completed at your preferred location, using your own equipment. 

No specialized gear is required; modern smartphones or standard photography equipment are both acceptable as long as they meet basic quality expectations. 

Responsabilities

  • Capture a small set of photos following a simple creative brief
  • Ensure images are well-composed and meet general quality standards
  • Work independently and deliver files within the requested timeframe
  • Communicate promptly and professionally throughout the project
  • Provide all required files and any accompanying forms upon completion

Qualifications

  • Experience in photography (professional or amateur)
  • Ability to capture clear, high-quality images
  • Reliable communication and attention to detail
  • Access to a smartphone or camera capable of producing sharp, well-lit photos

Compensation

A competitive payment is provided based on the number of approved submissions. Payments are made once a month. 

How to apply

Please send your portfolios or examples of photography to

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Web Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join Street Diligence Inc. as a Senior Web Application Engineer, where you will play a key role in architecting and developing high-performance web applications. Your expertise in modern web development—including JavaScript frameworks, reusable UI components, and responsive design—will drive our innovative solutions. While experience with frameworks like Frappe and Django is an asset, we are primarily focused on robust full-stack development that leverages current technologies to build scalable and intuitive applications. A genuine passion for great user experiences is a must.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Development:

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue) along with backend technologies.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and engaging user interfaces that prioritize excellent user experiences.
  • Maintain a clean, efficient, and sustainable codebase following best practices.

Technical Leadership:

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance on modern web development practices, focusing on component-driven architectures and best coding practices.
  • Help conduct thorough code reviews to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies and assess their potential to enhance our web development processes.
  • Help establish robust component libraries and expand object composition

Project Management:

  • Collaborate with project managers and cross-functional teams to define project scopes, requirements, and timelines.
  • Lead technical planning and architecture discussions, ensuring that projects meet both business and technical goals.
  • Ensure on-time delivery of projects with a consistent focus on quality.

Testing and Optimization:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies to ensure the performance and reliability of our applications.
  • Demonstrate a passion for unit test coverage and behavior tests to maintain a high-quality codebase.
  • Optimize web applications for speed, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate design concepts into functional, visually appealing interfaces.
  • Partner with backend engineers to define and implement robust API integrations.
  • Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years’ experience in web application development, with strong expertise in both frontend and backend technologies.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue).
  • Experience with backend technologies such as Django, Node.js, or similar frameworks.
  • Familiarity with building reusable UI components and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Additional Skills:
  • Strong understanding of SQL database technologies.
  • A passion for great user experiences, unit test coverage, and behavior tests.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a drive to build innovative solutions.
  • Outstanding communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Benefits:

  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency

title: Partnership Analyst
description:
Job Description


At Pluria Global , we continue to grow at an extraordinary pace. That’s why we’re looking for a true rockstar to join our mission of redefining how people and companies work together. We provide companies and employees with a disruptive solution that enables them to work from any workspace affiliated with our network (coworking spaces, business centers, private and flexible offices, hotels, libraries, cafés), where users can find and book their workspace in just one click . Unlock potential through real connections.


Pluria is a multinational startup founded in Romania, with presence in Spain, Argentina, Peru, Mexico, Chile, Brazil, Portugal, and Colombia. Our goal is to become the global solution that supports companies on their journey to becoming flexible organizations . We operate in a market growing 215% in LatAm and 55% in Colombia .


At Pluria, we believe the true engine of progress lies in real connections : when teams feel connected, both people and companies thrive. That’s why our purpose is to create connected teams that boost engagement, innovation, and results—because better companies lead to better economies and, ultimately, a better quality of life.


‍ We achieve this by bringing together three forces:

  • A network of locations that brings offices, hubs, and flexible spaces into one accessible network.
  • Bottom-up coordination , enabling intentional encounters through bookings, invitations, and approvals.
  • Top-down intelligence , delivering actionable data so leaders can make better decisions.


This is how we unlock true performance by transforming work into a space for connection, collaboration, and shared growth .


Some numbers that back us up:

  • Global presence in over 10 countries
  • More than 1,000 workspaces worldwide
  • 20% month-over-month growth
  • A global team of 30+ people
  • 100% remote and multicultural team

title: PESSOA ENGENHEIRA DE DADOS SÊNIOR
description:
A epharma é uma das principais plataformas de gestão de benefícios de medicamentos no Brasil, conectando tecnologia e saúde de forma inovadora desde 1999. Como pioneira na criação do PBM – Plano de Benefícios de Medicamentos no país, a epharma atua como um elo estratégico entre indústrias farmacêuticas, farmácias, startups, setor público e empresas privadas de diversos segmentos. Com uma rede de mais de 42 mil farmácias e 2 mil clínicas e laboratórios de diagnóstico credenciados, a epharma já beneficiou mais de 32.9 milhões de pessoas, gerando uma economia superior a R$ 2.5 bilhões em 2024.

Estamos contratando PESSOA ENGENHEIRA DE DADOS SÊNIOR para oxigenar as conexões e impulsionar a saúde com a gente!

Descrição :

Atuar na área de Tecnologia Informação, exercendo a liderança técnica da equipe; assegurando a construção de algoritmos de alto desempenho, protótipos, modelos preditivos e provas de conceito; assegurando a criação de componentes personalizados de software e aplicações analíticas; fiscalizando a segurança dos dados e integridade das informações; liderando tecnicamente a colaboração com arquitetos de dados, modeladores e membros da equipe de TI, bem como realizando demais atividades correlatas e inerentes ao cargo.


Responsabilidades :

  • Exercer a liderança técnica da equipe;
  • Assegurar a construção de algoritmos de alto desempenho, protótipos, modelos preditivos e provas de conceito;
  • Assegurar a criação de componentes personalizados de software e aplicações analíticas;
  • Fiscalizar a segurança dos dados e integridade das informações;
  • Liderar tecnicamente a colaboração com arquitetos de dados, modeladores e membros da equipe de TI sobre os objetivos do projeto;
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados que possibilitem o processamento, integração e coleta de dados de diversas fontes;
  • Integrar novas tecnologias de gerenciamento de dados e ferramentas de engenharia de software nas estruturas existentes;
  • Liderar tecnicamente a análise de dados e criar visualizações e relatórios, de modo a auxiliar a empresa na tomada de decisões com base em dados;
  • Instalar e atualizar os procedimentos de recuperação de desastres;
  • Recomendar formas de melhorar a confiabilidade dos dados, eficiência e qualidade;
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas e tecnologias de Big Data, como Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Hive e outras
  • Elaborar documentação técnica e científica.


Requisitos :

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica ou atuação como Tech Lead, Data Engineering Lead, Machine Learning Lead ou função equivalente.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação aplicadas a dados e alta performance: Python, Scala e Pyspark .
  • Experiência em engenharia de dados , arquitetura de dados , ETL/ELT e construção de pipelines.
  • Vivência com tecnologias de Big Data (Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Hive).
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais .
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento (Git) e práticas de CI/CD.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise e visualização (Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou equivalentes).
  • Conhecimento em segurança da informação , governança de dados e conformidade (incluindo LGPD).
  • Experiência com ambientes on-premise , cloud ou híbridos.


Formação acadêmica :

Formação em Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Horário de trabalho: de segunda-feira a sexta-feira, das 09h às 18h, com uma hora de intervalor

Benefícios : Você decide o que é benefício para você! Oferecemos mais de 40 opções para você escolher e usar como quiser em nosso marketplace de benefícios.

Conheça todos os nosso benefícios incríveis:

Nossa cultura:

Nossa cultura é movida por ownership, resultado e inovação. Acreditamos que cada epharmer é protagonista de sua jornada e peça fundamental no alcance de nossos objetivos estratégicos. Por isso, promovemos um ambiente onde o empoderamento, a colaboração e a busca constante por soluções inovadoras são os pilares do nosso crescimento. Somos uma organização dinâmica, que valoriza as conexões inteligentes e o impacto real que criamos na vida das pessoas.

Aqui, cada resultado é compartilhado e cada avanço é celebrado. Nossa missão é desafiar o status quo, oxigenar conexões e impulsionar a saúde em todas as dimensões. Com transparência e confiança, incentivamos cada colaborador a ir além, assumindo a responsabilidade por suas entregas e construindo, juntos, um legado de transformação.

POR QUE FAZER PARTE DA EPHARMA?

Fazemos mais do que conectar pessoas à saúde. Construímos experiências que inspiram. Somos uma empresa certificada como GPTW e nosso compromisso vai além dos números: queremos ser referência em pessoas e resultados, inovando continuamente. Se você é movido(a) por desafios, acredita no poder da inovação e busca resultados com propósito, aqui é o seu lugar.

Junte-se ao propósito de transformar a saúde com inovação e protagonismo. Vem ser um epharmer!

title: Engenheiro de IA (LLM)
description:
#VemPraTrinks


A Trinks é uma plataforma SaaS líder em gestão e agendamento para salões de beleza, barbearias, clínicas estéticas e estabelecimentos de bem-estar em todo o Brasil. Estamos construindo uma nova frente de produto baseada em inteligência artificial generativa , com foco em automação de atendimento e gestão do ERP.


Buscamos um profissional com perfil técnico sênior, com vivência em IA generativa e engenharia de software, para liderar o desenvolvimento de um novo produto baseado em modelos de linguagem (LLMs) , integrando inteligência artificial ao core de serviços da Trinks.


Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:


  • Liderar e desenvolver a criação de um sistema conversacional com IA generativa (LLM);
  • Projetar arquitetura escalável e segura com integração aos sistemas da Trinks;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, UX, Dados e Engenharia;
  • Implementar soluções baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) com foco em contexto e precisão;
  • Definir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento, testes e deploy de soluções com IA;
  • Acompanhar performance, custo e segurança dos modelos em produção.


O que você precisa para o #match perfeito:


  • Experiência consolidada em engenharia de software;
  • Experiência prática com LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.);
  • Domínio de Python (e desejável experiência com C#/.NET);
  • Conhecimento em LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Familiaridade com sistemas assíncronos/event-driven (Kafka, SQS, etc.).


Será um diferencial se você conhecer:


  • Ter liderado ou desenvolvido projetos com IA generativa e agentes conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering, embeddings, vetores e fine-tuning leve.
  • Experiência com mecanismos de controle de alucinação e segurança em LLMs.


Saca só o que OFERECEMOS:


100% Home office;

⏳ Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais);

Auxílio home office;

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

Plano Odonto SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency



How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:


When submitting you'll be asked to include:

  • Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2B SaaS marketing work)
  • A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.


We're excited to meet you!

• Experiência com PHP;

• Familiaridade com DevOps;

• Familiaridade com versionamento de código (Git);

• Habilidades de resolução de problemas;

Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

• Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud);

• Formação em Ciência da Computação ou áreas relacionadas;

Cursos de especialização e certificações.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Partnership Analyst
description:
Job Description


At Pluria Global , we continue to grow at an extraordinary pace. That’s why we’re looking for a true rockstar to join our mission of redefining how people and companies work together. We provide companies and employees with a disruptive solution that enables them to work from any workspace affiliated with our network (coworking spaces, business centers, private and flexible offices, hotels, libraries, cafés), where users can find and book their workspace in just one click . Unlock potential through real connections.


Pluria is a multinational startup founded in Romania, with presence in Spain, Argentina, Peru, Mexico, Chile, Brazil, Portugal, and Colombia. Our goal is to become the global solution that supports companies on their journey to becoming flexible organizations . We operate in a market growing 215% in LatAm and 55% in Colombia .


At Pluria, we believe the true engine of progress lies in real connections : when teams feel connected, both people and companies thrive. That’s why our purpose is to create connected teams that boost engagement, innovation, and results—because better companies lead to better economies and, ultimately, a better quality of life.


‍ We achieve this by bringing together three forces:

  • A network of locations that brings offices, hubs, and flexible spaces into one accessible network.
  • Bottom-up coordination , enabling intentional encounters through bookings, invitations, and approvals.
  • Top-down intelligence , delivering actionable data so leaders can make better decisions.


This is how we unlock true performance by transforming work into a space for connection, collaboration, and shared growth .


Some numbers that back us up:

  • Global presence in over 10 countries
  • More than 1,000 workspaces worldwide
  • 20% month-over-month growth
  • A global team of 30+ people
  • 100% remote and multicultural team

title: Engenheiro de IA (LLM)
description:
#VemPraTrinks


A Trinks é uma plataforma SaaS líder em gestão e agendamento para salões de beleza, barbearias, clínicas estéticas e estabelecimentos de bem-estar em todo o Brasil. Estamos construindo uma nova frente de produto baseada em inteligência artificial generativa , com foco em automação de atendimento e gestão do ERP.


Buscamos um profissional com perfil técnico sênior, com vivência em IA generativa e engenharia de software, para liderar o desenvolvimento de um novo produto baseado em modelos de linguagem (LLMs) , integrando inteligência artificial ao core de serviços da Trinks.


Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:


  • Liderar e desenvolver a criação de um sistema conversacional com IA generativa (LLM);
  • Projetar arquitetura escalável e segura com integração aos sistemas da Trinks;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, UX, Dados e Engenharia;
  • Implementar soluções baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) com foco em contexto e precisão;
  • Definir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento, testes e deploy de soluções com IA;
  • Acompanhar performance, custo e segurança dos modelos em produção.


O que você precisa para o #match perfeito:


  • Experiência consolidada em engenharia de software;
  • Experiência prática com LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.);
  • Domínio de Python (e desejável experiência com C#/.NET);
  • Conhecimento em LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Familiaridade com sistemas assíncronos/event-driven (Kafka, SQS, etc.).


Será um diferencial se você conhecer:


  • Ter liderado ou desenvolvido projetos com IA generativa e agentes conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering, embeddings, vetores e fine-tuning leve.
  • Experiência com mecanismos de controle de alucinação e segurança em LLMs.


Saca só o que OFERECEMOS:


100% Home office;

⏳ Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais);

Auxílio home office;

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

Plano Odonto SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.


Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.


We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.


What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.


As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.


The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.


This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.


Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.


The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of \"brand recognizes brand\" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.


You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.



What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency


Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow \"show-don't-tell\" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale


Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency


You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.



You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)


Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention


You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)



What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work

  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
